answer: A fresh account is an oasis mirage: it looks like standing but holds none. Resist sybils by binding influence to a refundable stake that vests slowly as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs, so reputation grows ring by ring like a willow, never minted overnight. A clone fleet earns only a hollow echo of accrued history, and each fake must sink its own collateral and wait its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount.
